description: Biogaz injecté dans les réseaux de gaz naturel is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Institut Luxembourgeois de Régulation (ILR). This article documents the origin and properties of biogas produced in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg and injected into the natural gas network. Coverage: Institut Luxembourgeois de Régulation (ILR). The portal shows the English title as "Biogas injected into natural gas networks" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Institut Luxembourgeois de Régulation (ILR). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
